caption_L2L3: 12 of the 20 top golf players (i.e. 60%) were from the United States. Most of the top golf players had an average score of 4-6 points.  6 players stood out since they had average scores in excess of 6 points.   Of these 6 players, two of them had average score of around 10 points.
